jd.text:
Job Description
Full Stack Developer
Posting Date: 14/10/2026
Country: Saudi Arabia
Location: King Abdullah Economic City, Mecca
Function: Digital
Experience: 3 - 5 years

DISCOVER PIRELLI

We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people!

Pirelli MEAI (Middle East, Africa & India) & Russia, with its headquarters in Dubai, supports commercial operations, business planning, innovation, and customer excellence across countries in the region.

DRIVE YOUR FUTURE

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer to design, build and ship digital products and features across our entire business processes, from the user interface to the APIs and data layer. You’ll work closely with other engineers, take ownership of work from idea to production, and help raise the quality of our codebase.

WHY JOIN US
We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with:

Hybrid Remote Working.
Employee benefits.

YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES

Build and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using modern frameworks.
Design and implement scalable back-end services, REST/GraphQL APIs and data models.
Take features from specification through development, testing, deployment and monitoring.
Write clean, tested and well-documented code, and take part in code reviews.
Optimize application performance, security and reliability.
Integrate third-party services and internal systems.
Contribute to architecture decisions and to improving CI/CD and developer tooling.
Troubleshoot production issues and help improve incident response.
Mentor junior developers and share knowledge across the team.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

3+ years of professional experience in full stack development.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and a front-end framework (React, Vue or Angular).
Back-end experience with Node.js, Python, Java, .NET or similar.
Solid knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL).
Familiarity with Git, workflows, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Good understanding of web security, performance and accessibility basics.
Clear communication and a collaborative approach.

NICE TO HAVE

Cloud experience (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture or serverless.
Knowledge of observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry).
Open-source contributions or technical writing.
Knowledge of NoSQL databases (MongoDB, ElasticSearch).

OUR STACK

[Front end: e.g. React, TypeScript, Next.js] · [Back end: e.g. Node.js, Python] · [Data: e.g. PostgreSQL, Redis] · [Infra: e.g. AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions]

, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE!
#WePirelli
